macros.name: hangpara
macros.doc: The command \hangpara{⟨indent⟩}{⟨afternum⟩} placed at the start of a paragraph will cause it to be typeset as a hanging paragraph.

macros.name: nhlq
macros.doc:
If a non-hanging period, or left or right quote character is required in it’s character form within the hangpunct environment, then respectively the 
hpt, 
hlq and 
hrq commands can be used.

macros.name: nhpt
macros.doc:
If a non-hanging period, or left or right quote character is required in it’s character form within the hangpunct environment, then respectively the 
hpt, 
hlq and 
hrq commands can be used.

envs.name: hangparas
envs.doc: The hangparas environment can be used for typeseting a sequence of hanging paragraphs.

envs.name: hangpunct
envs.doc: Text within the hangpunct environment will be typeset with hanging punctuation.
